about: Published vulnerabilities in what a deployment installs that are NOT fixed yet, each with why it cannot reach a user of this app and a date to look again. scripts/qa/dependencies.mjs fails on an entry past its date, and on an entry for something no longer reported. Read 2026-10-13, after next 15.5.25 -> 15.5.27 and `npm audit fix` took nine high findings to these four.

accepted.reason: The copy Next 15 installs for itself (8.4.31). It runs while the app is BUILT, over this repository's own stylesheets, and never over anything a visitor sends: the club's theme is a string the app writes itself (themeCss), not parsed CSS. The published fix is Next 16.4, a major upgrade that is planned and is three rounds of testing on its own.

Inside the Prisma command-line tool (prisma generate, prisma migrate deploy), where it merges Prisma's own configuration. It is not in the running app and is handed nothing from a request. The fix is deepmerge-ts 8, which no Prisma 6 or 7 release carries yet.
Reported only because it carries deepmerge-ts — see that entry.
Reported only because it carries @prisma/config, which carries deepmerge-ts — see that entry. The command-line tool, not the client the app queries with.
